notes: Each capability claim in the README, the site home and spec 18 carries a marker and points here; scripts/claim-proof-gate.mjs fails when a pointer or marker stops resolving.

claims.statement: A correction worth keeping becomes memory the Coordinator brings back when it matters, and a failed run writes its lessons into the next attempt.

anchors.text: It remembers your corrections.
记住你纠正过的事。
Remembers what you correct
what you correct becomes memory

claims.statement: The second time the user corrects the same thing, the Coordinator points at the saved rule and offers to add a repository check as a task; it never installs one unasked.

anchors.text: A mistake you correct twice becomes a check.
同一个错再犯，就加一道检查。
A repeat mistake becomes a check
a mistake that repeats becomes a check

claims.statement: Recorded Coordinator turns, coding tasks and canaries run daily against a task set and scorers kept in a protected path and read from the merge base, so an agent change cannot rewrite the exam it is judged by.

anchors.text: It is measured on an exam it cannot edit.
用一套它改不了的评测量自己。
Measured on an exam it cannot edit
An eval ruler the agents cannot edit

claims.statement: A change to prompts, skills, routing or tool use is kept only when it beats the current harness on that exam with delivery and interruption guards; this rule is being built, not shipped.

anchors.text: Improvements are kept only after they pass (being built).
得分更高，才留下（正在做）。
Kept only when it scores better
The keep rule is being built

claims.statement: Before changing anything, a thread reads how strong open-source projects solved the problem, then decides the details itself.

anchors.text: Research, then build.
先研究，再动手。
Research, then build in its worktree

claims.statement: Threads run on the user's own machines, one Runner per machine and a git worktree per task, on the user's own ChatGPT / Codex, Claude Code or API-key subscription; Cairn resells no compute.

anchors.text: Your machines, your subscriptions.
你的机器，你的订阅。
On your machines, with your subscriptions
on your own machines and with your own subscriptions
Each build edits and verifies in its own git worktree

claims.statement: A merge verdict counts only for the patch it judged: it binds to the patch digest and the reviewed head, and the gate's TLA+ models are checked with negative controls.

anchors.text: An evidence-bound merge gate, model-checked

claims.statement: Merges, sends, deletes and credential changes wait for the user's yes.

anchors.text: Nothing irreversible without your yes.
撤不回的事，先停下来问你。
Nothing irreversible without your yes
Anything that cannot be undone
